description: Every file of the pinned Tectonic DirBundle, by name, size and SHA-256, and where tools/provision_tectonic.py fetches it from. Names and digests only: no content of any third-party file is in this repository. The tree hash of these entries must equal bundle.sha256 in tectonic_runtime.lock.json.

tectonic-bundle.how: tectonic -X bundle cat NAME, run with the verified Tectonic binary against its built-in default bundle
tectonic-bundle.license: per-package TeX licences (LPPL, SIL OFL 1.1, GUST Font License and others)

bundle-digest.how: the bundle's own SHA256SUM, from tectonic -X bundle cat SHA256SUM, stored with one trailing newline

fandol.how: the file of that name inside the first archive below that has it with the pinned size and SHA-256; archives are tried in order and a source that fails (network, certificate or digest) is skipped

archives.what: TeX Live 2025 final, COPYING and README (frozen)
the same archive on a second TeX Live mirror
